revision_note: v2 (before any run) replaces v1 of commit 7d28d9cb: owner 2026-10-20 ~04:30Z: run concurrently with a foreign correctness-only lock, interleave arms, judge paired old-vs-new deltas, record foreign activity
replica: one Query replica per arm, production container spec of query_kn_1 except private cache/quota Redis, --cpus 1.0 --memory 2g (the IDR-129 arm shape)
order: byte compare (A and B side by side), then interleaved arms A1 B1 A2 B2 (A = old, B = new), each a fresh replica
concurrency: runs beside another agent's correctness-only job under its host lock (owner instruction); foreign activity sampled every 30 s

burst.mix: TS r11 BAR 1m x 1,000 rows (10 slices) + alpha-okx BAR 1m..1h cycled to 54 slices with rows 2500/5000/2500/5000/2500/5000/2500/10000 (the IDR-129 stage ladder); SDK 2.4 redirect/queued retry shape
burst.note: alpha-binance identities belong to the rotated CA, so alpha slices are alpha-okx only

hot_reads.driver: open loop, fixed schedule (no coordinated omission), TS identity
hot_reads.request: GET /v2/market-data/{uid}/snapshot, TS r11 QUOTE and TRADE requirements (EXECUTION), round robin
hot_reads.rate_note: 4x the production rate so that a ~150 ms maintenance run overlaps reads (about 1.5 expected per run)
hot_reads.production_reference: R4 soak 2026-10-20: 7261 QUOTE + 1800 TRADE in 60 min = 2.5/s over two replicas
hot_reads.phases: pre (60 s before burst 1), scored (first burst start .. last burst end), post (60 s)

maintenance: the new image's default QDL_QUERY_MEMORY_SOFT_LIMIT_MIB (448); no manual gc/trim in any scored arm

rules.HR1: paired deltas over the pairs (A1,B1) and (A2,B2), scored hot reads (any HTTP status; transport errors counted apart): mean(p95_Bi - p95_Ai) <= max(0.10*mean(p95_Ai), 10 ms) and mean(p99_Bi - p99_Ai) <= max(0.10*mean(p99_Ai), 25 ms); each pair is reported
rules.HR2: coverage: the B arms together have >= 1 memory_maintenance run inside a scored window with >= 1 hot read overlapping it; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (never PASS)
rules.HR3: bounded pause: every hot read overlapping a maintenance run has latency <= run_ms + p99 of that arm's non-overlapping scored reads + 50 ms, and every run_ms <= 500
rules.HR4: transport errors + HTTP 5xx summed over B arms <= summed over A arms + max(2, 0.5 % of the B arms' scored reads)
rules.HR5: non-200 share of scored reads over the B arms <= over the A arms + 1 percentage point
rules.BC: for every TS r11 requirement, in each of 2 passes, a valid triple (A, B, A' = second request to A, issued together with the sync paused) exists within 3 attempts; valid = A and A' differ only in scalar leaves (V); PASS when for every valid triple: status A == B, content-type A == B, Content-Length header == body length on A and B, no Transfer-Encoding, the JSON leaf paths where A and B differ are a subset of V, and the bodies are byte-equal after replacing the raw values at V by one placeholder
rules.verdict: PASS only when HR1-HR5 and BC all PASS; INCONCLUSIVE when HR2 is not met; FAIL otherwise
rules.secondary: RSS per burst, warmup latency, 429 counts and failed slices are reported, not gated
